annotations.title: Elliott Wave count for one market

description: The latest called Elliott Wave count for one market, made at its last completed close: the wave in progress, the price that invalidates the count, and for each timeframe (monthly, weekly, daily, hourly, 15-minute) the wave in progress, its target zone and its invalidation price. Returns Markdown, plus the same data as structuredContent (called_count, invalid_if, levels[]). Use list_markets or search_markets first if unsure which symbols are covered.

symbol.description: The market's symbol or name, case-insensitive. Examples: SPX, NVDA, BTC-USD (or bitcoin), GOLD (or gold), EURUSD, NIFTY. A leading $ is ignored. The closest match is used.
